answer: Re-attestations are stored in wander and walnut lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 18 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the voyage graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 223 impostors cost 362 times the honest price and take 25 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
